category_rationale: Essential for retouching photography, compositing images, and preparing raster assets for print or digital layouts.

do_nothing_test.note: retouched_portrait.png does not exist before agent acts. Returns score=0 immediately.

partial_test.example: Agent only applies Levels (contrast) and exports. Criteria 1, 2, 3 pass. Criteria 4 (color correction) and 5 (vignette) fail if only one tool was used. Score ~60%.

verification_criteria.label: retouched_portrait.png exists and is valid
verification_criteria.check: File exists on Desktop, PIL can open it

verification_criteria.label: Significant pixel changes from source
verification_criteria.check: Mean abs diff > 8.0 OR > 20% pixels changed by > 10 value

verification_criteria.label: Color correction applied
verification_criteria.check: Sum of channel mean shifts > 15, OR channel std reduced by > 5

verification_criteria.label: Vignette effect present
verification_criteria.check: Center region brightness > corner region brightness by > 10

source_image.subject: Historical portrait photograph (Abraham Lincoln or similar)

gimp_features_required: Colors → Levels or Colors → Curves (tonal range)
Colors → Curves (individual channel adjustments for color cast)
Script-Fu vignette OR ellipse selection + Gaussian blur + burn (vignette)
validation_notes: Task was statically validated. The portrait source has naturally compressed tonal range and slight color imbalance due to age, making tonal and color corrections verifiable. Vignette criterion requires deliberate edge-darkening action.
